content.title: 'Invincible' season 4 finale episode release schedule: When is episode 8 streaming on Prime Video?
content.text: (Image credit: Courtesy of Prime Video) "Invincible" season 4 kicked things off with a three-episode premiere back in March, but the season finale is already upon us. So you'd better start watching if you're only now trying to figure out how to stream the Prime Video superhero show.The good news is that reviews have been good; I gave it 3.5 out of five stars in my season 4 premiere review. On Rotten Tomatoes, the new season is currently rated 100% fresh by critics and 87% by audiences, which is exceptional. With that buzz, it's no surprise you want to watch this series, whether you watched the past three seasons or are brand-new to Mark Grayson's (Steven Yeun) fight against his father's Viltrumite Empire.Latest Videos From Tom's GuideBest Gifts for the person who has everything0 seconds of 30 secondsVolume 0%'Invincible' season 4: Episode 8 release date and time (Image credit: Prime Video)While "Invincible" season 4 had a three-episode premiere on March 18 on Prime Video, that won't be the norm. The "Invincible" season 4 finale, episode 8, will premiere on Wed., April 22 at 3 a.m. ET / 12 a.m. PT on Prime Video.'Invincible' season 4 full episode release schedule Invincible Season 4 - Official Trailer | Prime Video - YouTube Watch On If you're planning your watchlist, here's the full "Invincible" season 4 episode release schedule."Invincible" season 4, episode 1: "Making the World a Better Place" — March 18"Invincible" season 4, episode 2: "I'll Give You the Grand Tour" — March 18"Invincible" season 4, episode 3: "I Gotta Get Some Air" — March 18"Invincible" season 4, episode 4: "Hurm" — March 25"Invincible" season 4, episode 5: "Give Us a Moment" — April 1"Invincible" season 4, episode 6: "You Look Horrible" — April 8"Invincible" season 4, episode 7: "Don't Do Anything Rash" — April 15"Invincible" season 4, episode 8: "Don't Leave Me Hanging Here" — April 22How to stream 'Invincible' season 4 for free on Prime VideoIf you're hoping to watch new episodes of "Invincible" season 4 for free, I have some good news. This superhero series streams on Prime Video, which comes free with an Amazon Prime subscription.Even better, you can currently try Prime free for 30 days (new subscribers only). So, if you have an email, you can stream "Invincible" for free.Now, while Prime Video is free with Prime, you can pay extra to remove ads and get 4K streaming resolution. But that's only if you want to. You don't need to pay extra to watch "Invincible" season 4 right now. What do you think? What's your favorite season of Invincible? Thanks for voting!
